name: Saturnbeam
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: The IDO project SaturnBeam of MoonSwap, a decentralized exchange on the Moonriver chain, ran away, and MoonSwap tweeted a warning that SaturnBeam would refund the money within 24 hours.
